final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* input gain stage (cascoded CS), gain node = ibias (IREF is its current-source load)
M1   n1    iin   vss  vss  nfet W=24 L=0.25
M1c  ibias vcas  n1   vss  nfet W=12 L=0.15
Rload vdd  ibias 300k
* cascode gate bias
R1   vdd   vcas  800k
R2   vcas  vss   1Meg
Cc   vcas  vss   1p
* source-follower output buffer (inside the feedback loop)
Msf  vdd   ibias vout vss  nfet W=12 L=0.15
Rs   vout  vss   45k
* transimpedance feedback
Rf   vout  iin   430k
.ends
